newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa unit juggles coal mine production.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa unit juggles coal mine production.

text.p: Mexican steel giant Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa) said Monday that its coal mine unit has decided to close one mine and expand exploration and output at others in a juggling of production levels.

Ahmsa said in a statement to the Mexican Stock Exchange that its Minerales Monclova coal unit, which operates five mines, is closing down its mine No. 1 in the Palau region because it has exhausted its mineral reserves.
Ahmsa said its other operating mines and and mines in preparatory stages would assure coal output for Ahmsa's steel production needs.
